description: This file defines models and logic for an event management module in an OpenERP (Odoo) system, including classes for events, registrations, event types, and reporting views.

classes.name: crm_case_log
classes.description: Log model inheriting 'crm.case.log' with custom create method and default user_id

classes.name: event_type
classes.description: Model representing event types with a name field

classes.name: event
classes.description: Main event model with fields for dates, type, registration limits, state, and methods for state transitions, copying, and related computations

classes.name: event_registration
classes.description: Model for event registrations, inheriting 'crm.case', with methods for email notifications, invoice line creation, and state management

classes.name: report_event_registration
classes.description: SQL view for reporting events and registration counts

classes.name: report_event_type_registration
classes.description: SQL view for reporting registration counts by event type

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a crm.case.log entry with default name if not provided

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates an event, assigning a new sequence code and resetting state to draft

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the event and sends confirmation emails if auto-confirm is enabled

methods.name: _get_register
methods.description: Computes the number of confirmed registrations for an event

methods.name: _get_prospect
methods.description: Computes the number of unconfirmed (draft) registrations for an event

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to update related registration deadlines and descriptions based on event changes

methods.name: _history
methods.description: Logs case history entries for registration actions

methods.name: button_reg_close
methods.description: Marks registration as done and logs history

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a registration, setting section, deadline, and description from the event

methods.name: mail_user
methods.description: Sends registration or confirmation emails based on auto-mail settings
